gaps.valueSet: Rule 2 antibody laboratory result value greater than zero
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory-result comparison; TRI-R2 retains the source's coded positive, Trichinella-result, and abnormal-interpretation alternatives

the source rule requires consumption of an implicated meal or food with suspected or confirmed Trichinella contamination; both criteria are marked not implemented with no codes and SEM_V1 has no equivalent evidence, so the rule is omitted rather than allowing clinical findings alone to report
the source identifies death-certificate evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
